name: Quantized Binary Histograms for Semi-Transparent Rendering
definition: A technique to determine if a spatial region (brick) is fully transparent in pre-classification volume rendering by using conservative quantized binary histograms, avoiding false transparent/opaque classification errors common with min/max values.
summary: Quantized Binary Histograms is a conservative pre-processing technique that uses quantized binary histograms to determine if a volume brick is fully transparent, enabling space leaping to skip rendering empty regions.
